desc: Aartech Solonics Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 05/09/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve agenda items as per the attached intimation of Board Meeting.

The Company has completed the electronic dispatch of the Annual Report, including the Notice of the 44th Annual General Meeting of the Company for the Financial Year 2025-26, to its members on 05th September, 2026. Further, in compliance with the applicable regulatory requirements, please find enclosed copies of the newspaper advertisements published in English and Hindi editions on Sunday, September 06, 2026.
